title: the MCP server answers an initialize over stdio
question: does `bb mcp` speak the protocol, or does it only claim to?
rule: README: `bb mcp` serves the zero-token verbs as an MCP server over stdio.

steps.name: it answers initialize
steps.run: printf '%s\n' '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2024-11-05","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"bb-corpus","version":"1"}}}' | timeout 10 node bin/bb.js mcp | head -1
